name: Saskop
description: Saskop or Sasku is an Estonian four-player partnership game in the Schafkopf group. A 36-card deck is used, with picture cards as permanent high trumps and the 6 of the chosen trump suit highest of all.

content.text: Saskop or Sasku is an Estonian four-player partnership game in the Schafkopf group. A 36-card deck is used, with picture cards as permanent high trumps and the 6 of the chosen trump suit highest of all.

Derived from the German Schafkopf games brought to the Baltics in the 19th century. It evolved into a distinct Estonian folk game, adopting the name 'Lambapea' (Sheep's Head) in parallel with its German ancestor.
Each player receives 9 cards (the entire deck).

items.text: Deal method: Cutter may specify how cards are dealt: 3 at a time (default), one at a time, 9 at a time, or other patterns such as covers to us, content to us, or face-up until a chosen card appears.
Single picture exchange: After the deal, a player with only one picture card (K, Q, or J) may place it face up; partner passes one card face down in exchange.
Roof signal: A player with no picture cards may signal partner (e.g. fingertips forming a roof); some groups allow it, others treat it as illegal.
